title: Basic Training Blueprint+
subtitle: British Army assessment + basic training preparation
tagline: Pass assessment. Arrive ready. Leave nothing on the table.
purpose: Build the fitness, strength and durability required for British Army assessment and the physical demands of Basic Training.
independent_disclaimer: The Basic Training Blueprint is produced independently by SEVEN3SEVEN. It is not produced, approved or endorsed by the British Army or the Ministry of Defence.

sessions.title: Lower-body strength + pull position
sessions.purpose: Build a safe strength baseline and learn the position used for the Mid-Thigh Pull.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy bike or row, then ankle rocks, hip hinges, glute bridges and 3 progressive deadlift warm-up sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar deadlift or conventional deadlift: 3 x 5 at RPE 6-7. Rest 2-3 min. Every rep should look the same.

blocks.name: Assessment preparation
blocks.instruction: Secure rack isometric pull at mid-thigh: 4 x 3 sec at RPE 7, 90 sec rest. If no safe rack is available, complete 3 x 5 heavy kettlebell deadlifts instead.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Rear-foot elevated split squat 3 x 8 each leg; standing calf raise 3 x 12; tibialis raise 3 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min easy movement. Log the deadlift load, RPE and any pain or asymmetry.

sessions.coach_note: Do not chase a maximum. A useful baseline is repeatable and technically clean.

sessions.title: Aerobic baseline
sessions.purpose: Build continuous aerobic work without turning every run into a test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk, then begin with a very easy jog.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: Complete 25-35 min at RPE 4-5. You should be able to speak in full sentences. Use run/walk intervals if needed: 3 min run / 1 min walk.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 15 sec relaxed accelerations with 60-75 sec walking recovery.

blocks.name: Lower-leg capacity
blocks.instruction: 2 rounds: 12 bent-knee calf raises, 12 straight-knee calf raises, 20 sec single-leg balance each side.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Walk until breathing is normal. Record total time and whether you ran continuously.

sessions.coach_note: Easy training is not wasted training. The goal is to finish with more in the tank.

sessions.title: Upper-body strength + medicine-ball baseline
sessions.purpose: Measure the seated throw and begin building the pressing and pulling strength behind it.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min easy machine, shoulder circles, band pull-aparts, wall slides and 2 light sets of press-ups.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Official-style seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 3 attempts after 2-3 practice throws. Rest 60-90 sec. Record the longest valid distance.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press or dumbbell bench press: 3 x 8 at RPE 6-7. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Pull + press
blocks.instruction: Chest-supported row 3 x 10; half-kneeling dumbbell press 3 x 8 each side; press-ups 2 sets stopping 3 reps before failure.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: Dead bug 3 x 8 each side and side plank 2 x 25 sec each side.

sessions.coach_note: Throw for distance, not fatigue. Stop a set when speed or technique drops.

sessions.title: 2 km baseline assessment
sessions.purpose: Establish the running performance that will guide the next training block.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running, drills and 3 x 20 sec strides. Then complete the Army-style 800 m progressive warm-up.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Run 2 km continuously on a flat measured course or track at best sustainable effort. Record total time and 400 m or 1 km splits where possible.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: Walk for 5 min, then jog easily for 8-10 min.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Record where the pace changed, how the first kilometre felt and whether you finished faster or slower.

blocks.name: Optional
blocks.instruction: If you cannot yet run 2 km continuously, record the total time including short walks. That is still your baseline.

sessions.coach_note: Do not sprint the first 400 m. The best baseline is paced hard, not paced stupidly.

sessions.title: General military work capacity
sessions.purpose: Introduce carries, step-ups and bodyweight work without unnecessary impact.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy cardio, then rehearse every movement.

blocks.name: Main circuit
blocks.instruction: 4 quality rounds: 300 m easy-moderate run, 10 step-ups each leg, 8-15 press-ups, 20 m backpack or dumbbell front carry, and 30 sec front plank. Rest 90 sec between rounds.

blocks.name: Grip
blocks.instruction: Dead hang or farmer hold: 3 x 20-40 sec.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 5-8 min calves, ankles, hips and thoracic rotation.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record the version of each movement and whether round four matched round one.

sessions.coach_note: This is controlled capacity work, not a punishment circuit. Movement quality wins.

sessions.title: Deadlift volume + isometric pull
sessions.purpose: Increase useful lower-body strength volume while reinforcing the assessment pull position.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Easy machine, hinge drills, split squats and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 4 x 5 at RPE 7. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Pull position
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh rack isometric: 5 x 3 sec at RPE 7-8, 90 sec rest. Only use a properly secured bar and rack.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Goblet squat 3 x 10; walking lunge 3 x 8 each leg; calf raise 3 x 15; tibialis raise 3 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Suitcase carry 3 x 25 m each side at a controlled heavy load.

sessions.coach_note: Add load only if the final deadlift set still matches the first.

sessions.title: Aerobic base + strides
sessions.purpose: Extend the amount of work you can complete at a low physiological cost.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk into an easy jog.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 30-40 min at RPE 4-5. Foundation option: alternate 5 min run / 1 min walk.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 15 sec relaxed-fast with 60 sec walk or jog recovery.

blocks.name: Foot strength
blocks.instruction: 2 x 12 short-foot holds, 2 x 12 single-leg calf raises and 2 x 20 sec single-leg balance each side.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Log duration, distance and average heart rate if available.

sessions.coach_note: Do not increase both pace and duration. This week, duration is the progression.

sessions.title: Throw quality + upper volume
sessions.purpose: Improve explosive throwing mechanics and build balanced upper-body strength.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Band pull-aparts, wall slides, light chest passes and two easy press-up sets.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 5 x 3, full reset and 60-90 sec rest. Record the best throw of the day.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press or dumbbell bench: 4 x 8 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Pull + overhead
blocks.instruction: Assisted pull-up or lat pulldown 4 x 8; overhead press 3 x 8 at RPE 7; face pull 3 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups: 2 quality sets, stopping 2-3 reps before failure.

sessions.coach_note: Explosive work belongs at the start, while you are fresh.

sessions.title: Short intervals
sessions.purpose: Improve speed and running mechanics without excessive total volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy run, drills and 3 x 15 sec strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 8 x 1 min at RPE 8 with 90 sec easy jog or walk. Keep every hard rep within a similar distance.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min very easy running.

blocks.name: Lower-leg work
blocks.instruction: 2 x 15 calf raises and 2 x 12 tibialis raises.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record the distance or pace for each hard minute.

sessions.coach_note: The last interval may be hard. It should not be dramatically slower than the first.

sessions.title: Carry and bodyweight repeatability
sessions.purpose: Build the ability to work, recover and repeat with simple military-relevant patterns.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy cardio and movement rehearsal.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds, not for time: 250 m run, 10 goblet squats, 8-15 press-ups, 8 inverted rows or 20 sec rope/towel pull hold, 30 m farmer carry. Rest 60-90 sec.

blocks.name: Step-up density
blocks.instruction: 5 min continuous alternating step-ups at RPE 5-6.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: 3 x 30 sec front plank and 2 x 25 sec side plank each side.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Easy walk and log round consistency.

sessions.coach_note: Choose reps that leave one or two clean reps available in every round.

weeks.title: Build the engine and the frame

sessions.title: Strength build + pull intent
sessions.purpose: Develop more force through the hips and legs while practising aggressive, controlled pulling.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy machine, ankle and hip mobility, then progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 4 at RPE 7-7.5. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Pull position
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh rack isometric: 4 x 4 sec at RPE 8, 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Front-foot elevated split squat 3 x 8 each leg; Romanian deadlift 3 x 8 at RPE 7; calf raise 4 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Heavy farmer carry 4 x 25 m. Walk with control and tall posture.

sessions.coach_note: High intent does not mean losing position. Brace, pull hard and stop cleanly.

sessions.title: Long aerobic run
sessions.purpose: Increase aerobic capacity and durability through steady continuous running.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk and easy jog.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 35-45 min at RPE 4-5. Foundation option: 4 min run / 1 min walk for the full duration.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with 75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk and gentle calf mobility.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record duration, distance and whether the final 10 min felt controlled.

sessions.coach_note: This should be your easiest-feeling session of the week, despite being longer.

sessions.title: Upper power + push-pull strength
sessions.purpose: Connect explosive throwing with stronger pressing and pulling.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder mobility, light chest passes, band rows and progressive press sets.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated medicine-ball throw: 5 x 3. Then standing overhead throw or scoop throw: 3 x 3 if space is safe.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Push press: 5 x 3 at RPE 7. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Pull
blocks.instruction: Pull-up, assisted pull-up or pulldown: 4 x 6-8; one-arm dumbbell row 3 x 10 each side.

blocks.name: Press-up capacity
blocks.instruction: 3 sets at a repeatable number, stopping 2 reps before failure.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: Pallof press 3 x 10 each side.

sessions.coach_note: Do not turn the push press into a slow grind. Power disappears when the bar slows.

sessions.title: Two-minute intervals
sessions.purpose: Build speed endurance close to 2 km effort while preserving repeatability.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy running, drills and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 6 x 2 min at RPE 8 with 2 min easy jog. Performance option: complete 7-8 reps only if pace remains within 3%.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 2 x 12 bent-knee calf raises and 2 x 12 tibialis raises.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record pace or distance for each repetition.

sessions.coach_note: Earn extra repetitions through consistency. Do not add them because the session looks short on paper.

sessions.title: Introductory loaded walk
sessions.purpose: Begin adapting feet, calves, trunk and posture to controlled load carriage.

blocks.name: Preparation
blocks.instruction: Use a comfortable, secure backpack. Load: approximately 5% bodyweight, capped at 6 kg. Wear normal training clothing and suitable footwear.

blocks.name: Main walk
blocks.instruction: 30 min brisk walk at RPE 4-5 on mostly flat ground. Do not run.

blocks.name: After walk
blocks.instruction: 3 rounds: 10 step-ups each leg, 12 glute bridges, 10 press-ups and 20 sec dead hang or farmer hold.

blocks.name: Foot care
blocks.instruction: Check for rubbing or hotspots. Dry feet, change socks and record any problem areas.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min gentle mobility for calves, hips and upper back.

sessions.coach_note: Load carriage is a skill exposure. Running with a backpack is not part of this programme.

sessions.title: Light lower-body strength
sessions.purpose: Retain strength patterns while allowing fatigue to fall.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy bike or row and movement preparation.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 5 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Technique pull
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh rack isometric: 3 x 3 sec at RPE 6-7, or skip if the setup is not completely safe.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Goblet squat 2 x 10; split squat 2 x 8 each leg; calf raise 2 x 12; tibialis raise 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy bike or walk.

sessions.coach_note: Everything should feel crisp. Deloading is training, not laziness.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic reset
sessions.purpose: Maintain aerobic consistency with very low fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Begin with 5 min walking.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 25-30 min at RPE 3-4. Use run/walk freely.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12 sec smooth accelerations, not sprints.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 5-8 min ankles, calves, hips and thoracic rotation.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record general energy and lower-leg comfort.

sessions.coach_note: You should finish fresher than you began.

sessions.title: Light upper-body technique
sessions.purpose: Keep throwing and strength patterns familiar without creating soreness.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Easy machine, shoulder mobility and light medicine-ball practice.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated medicine-ball throw: 3 x 3 at approximately 80-90% effort.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press or dumbbell bench: 3 x 6 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Pull + shoulder
blocks.instruction: Chest-supported row 3 x 8; half-kneeling press 2 x 8 each side; face pull 2 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 2 easy sets of press-ups and 5 min mobility.

sessions.coach_note: Leave the gym wanting to do more. That is the correct outcome this week.

sessions.title: Technique fartlek
sessions.purpose: Keep some faster running while avoiding a heavy interval session.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy run.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 6 x 30 sec at RPE 7 with 90 sec easy jog.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 12-15 min easy running.

blocks.name: Drills
blocks.instruction: 2 rounds of A-march, ankling and 2 x 15 sec relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Walk until breathing is fully controlled.

sessions.coach_note: Fast enough to feel smooth, not fast enough to create a hangover.

sessions.title: Movement quality circuit
sessions.purpose: Maintain general capacity while reducing impact and total work.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy cardio.

blocks.name: Main circuit
blocks.instruction: 3 easy rounds: 8 step-ups each leg, 10 incline or floor press-ups, 10 ring rows, 20 m light carry and 30 sec plank. Rest as needed.

blocks.name: Easy flush
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min bike, row or brisk walk at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Longer calf, hip and shoulder mobility.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Check the Week 1-3 log and identify one area improving and one requiring attention.

sessions.coach_note: No score. No race. Move well and recover.

sessions.title: Heavy triples + pull force
sessions.purpose: Increase maximal-force capacity while keeping every rep technically sound.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy machine, hinge patterning and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 3 at RPE 8. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Pull position
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh rack isometric: 5 x 4 sec at RPE 8-9, 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Bulgarian split squat 3 x 6 each leg at RPE 8; hamstring curl 3 x 10; calf raise 4 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Farmer carry 4 x 30 m at RPE 7-8.

sessions.coach_note: RPE 8 means two clean reps remain. It does not mean an ugly near-max.

sessions.title: Threshold intervals
sessions.purpose: Raise the pace you can sustain before fatigue sharply accelerates.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy run and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 4 x 4 min at RPE 7-8 with 2 min easy jog. Keep the pace stable.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Lower-leg work
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12 calf raises and 2 x 15 tibialis raises.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record pace and RPE for each interval.

sessions.coach_note: Threshold is controlled discomfort. If you are sprinting, you have missed the point.

sessions.title: Bench strength + throw contrast
sessions.purpose: Use heavy pressing followed by explosive throws to develop upper-body force and speed.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder prep, light throws and progressive bench sets.

blocks.name: Contrast block
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds: bench press 5 reps at RPE 8, rest 60 sec, then 3 seated 4 kg medicine-ball throws. Rest 2 min before the next round.

blocks.name: Pull
blocks.instruction: Pull-up or pulldown 4 x 6-8; one-arm row 3 x 8 each side.

blocks.name: Overhead
blocks.instruction: Dumbbell overhead press 3 x 8 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 quality sets, stopping 2 reps before failure.

sessions.coach_note: The throw after the bench should still be fast. Reduce the bench load if it is not.

sessions.title: 400 m repeatability
sessions.purpose: Develop 2 km-specific rhythm and pacing using your current performance.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy running, drills and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 5-6 x 400 m at current 2 km average pace with 2 min walk/jog recovery. Foundation option: 6 x 90 sec at RPE 8.

blocks.name: Fast finish
blocks.instruction: 2 x 200 m relaxed-fast, full walk-back recovery.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Keep 400 m repetitions within 3 sec where possible.

sessions.coach_note: Do not use a fantasy goal pace. Train from the performance you actually produced.

sessions.title: Loaded walk + step-up strength
sessions.purpose: Progress load carriage gradually while strengthening the legs through repeated stepping.

blocks.name: Preparation
blocks.instruction: Backpack load: approximately 7.5% bodyweight, capped at 8 kg. Check straps and footwear.

blocks.name: Main walk
blocks.instruction: 35 min brisk walk at RPE 4-5 on mostly flat ground. Do not run.

blocks.name: After walk
blocks.instruction: 3 x 10 step-ups each leg holding a light load; 3 x 12 glute bridges; 3 x 30 sec front plank.

blocks.name: Foot care
blocks.instruction: Record hotspots, numbness or rubbing. Adjust the setup before the next loaded week.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min gentle mobility.

sessions.coach_note: If the load changes your gait, it is too heavy for this stage.

sessions.title: Strength volume + unilateral control
sessions.purpose: Add quality strength volume and improve single-leg control for running and stepping.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Easy row or bike, hinge drills, split squats and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 4 x 4 at RPE 7.5-8.

blocks.name: Pull position
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh isometric: 4 x 5 sec at RPE 8, 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Front squat or heavy goblet squat 4 x 6 at RPE 7; single-leg Romanian deadlift 3 x 8 each side; calf raise 4 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Suitcase carry 3 x 35 m each side.

sessions.coach_note: This week adds volume, not a new maximum. Keep rep speed consistent.

sessions.title: Extended aerobic run
sessions.purpose: Expand the aerobic base that supports faster running and recovery between hard efforts.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk into an easy jog.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 40-50 min at RPE 4-5. Foundation option: 8 min run / 1 min walk.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with 75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Walk 5 min and complete 2 x 12 calf raises plus 2 x 12 tibialis raises.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record whether pace stayed stable at the same effort.

sessions.coach_note: More aerobic fitness means you recover faster from everything else in this plan.

sessions.title: Push press power + throw quality
sessions.purpose: Develop whole-body pressing power while keeping the assessment throw highly specific.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder and thoracic mobility, light throws and progressive push press sets.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Push press: 5 x 3 at RPE 7.5. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Throw
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 5 x 3 with full rest.

blocks.name: Pull + press
blocks.instruction: Weighted or assisted pull-up 4 x 5-8; dumbbell bench 3 x 8 at RPE 7; face pull 3 x 15.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: Hollow hold 3 x 20-30 sec and side plank 2 x 30 sec each side.

sessions.coach_note: Separate strength from conditioning. Every power repetition should look aggressive and clean.

sessions.title: 500 m intervals
sessions.purpose: Improve the ability to hold hard running pace for repeated 2 km-specific efforts.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12-15 min easy running, drills and strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 6 x 500 m at current 2 km pace with 2 min easy recovery. Performance option: reduce recovery to 90 sec only if all reps are controlled.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Gentle calf and hip mobility.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record each split and the difference between fastest and slowest.

sessions.coach_note: The goal is six strong repetitions, not one hero rep and five survival reps.

sessions.title: Military capacity circuit
sessions.purpose: Build general work capacity across running, carrying, stepping, pushing and pulling.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy cardio and movement rehearsal.

blocks.name: Main circuit
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds: 300 m run at RPE 6, 12 alternating step-ups, 10-20 press-ups, 8 pull-ups/assisted pull-ups or 12 rows, 40 m farmer carry and 8 burpees. Rest 90 sec.

blocks.name: Grip
blocks.instruction: 3 x 30-45 sec dead hang or towel hold.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy walk or bike.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record round times and chosen movement versions.

sessions.coach_note: Scale the repetitions so round five remains recognisable as the same workout.

sessions.title: Heavy doubles + maximum intent
sessions.purpose: Develop high force without accumulating the fatigue of repeated maximal attempts.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy machine, mobility and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 2 at RPE 8-8.5. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Pull position
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh rack isometric: 5 x 3 sec at RPE 9, 2-3 min rest.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Rear-foot elevated split squat 4 x 6 each leg; hamstring curl 3 x 8; calf raise 4 x 10; tibialis raise 3 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Heavy farmer carry 5 x 25 m.

sessions.coach_note: No missed lifts. The benefit comes from force and quality, not grinding.

sessions.title: Long threshold intervals
sessions.purpose: Improve sustained hard running and resistance to pace fade.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy running and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 3 x 8 min at RPE 7-8 with 3 min easy jog. Foundation option: 4 x 5 min.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Lower-leg mobility and 2 x 12 calf raises.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record average pace for each interval.

sessions.coach_note: The final interval should be the hardest, not the slowest by default.

sessions.title: Heavy press + explosive throw
sessions.purpose: Push upper-body force higher while preserving throwing speed.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder prep, light throws and progressive bench sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press: 5 x 3 at RPE 8-8.5. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 6 x 2, full effort and full reset.

blocks.name: Pull
blocks.instruction: Pull-up or pulldown 5 x 5-8; chest-supported row 3 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Strict overhead press 3 x 6 at RPE 7 and press-ups 2 controlled sets.

sessions.coach_note: Low-repetition throws stay explosive. Do not add reps until they become slow.

sessions.title: 800 m repeats
sessions.purpose: Develop the ability to hold 2 km pace for longer continuous sections.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 15 min easy running, drills and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 4 x 800 m at current 2 km pace with 2.5-3 min easy recovery. Foundation option: 4 x 3 min at RPE 8.

blocks.name: Fast finish
blocks.instruction: 2 x 200 m relaxed-fast with full recovery.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy run.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record all 800 m splits and the final 200 m quality.

sessions.coach_note: If you cannot hold the target after rep two, adjust immediately rather than forcing poor mechanics.

sessions.title: Progressive loaded walk
sessions.purpose: Increase time under load while keeping posture, gait and feet under control.

blocks.name: Preparation
blocks.instruction: Backpack load: approximately 10% bodyweight, capped at 10 kg. Use a secure pack and flat-to-rolling terrain.

blocks.name: Main walk
blocks.instruction: 40 min brisk walk at RPE 5. Do not run. Aim for consistent pace.

blocks.name: After walk
blocks.instruction: 3 rounds: 12 step-ups each leg, 12 walking lunges each leg and 30 sec side plank each side.

blocks.name: Foot care
blocks.instruction: Inspect feet and record hotspots immediately.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Gentle calf, hip flexor and upper-back mobility.

sessions.coach_note: Do not increase load and duration together beyond the prescription.

sessions.title: Midpoint strength check
sessions.purpose: Measure progress without taking a reckless maximum.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy machine and progressive deadlift warm-up sets.

blocks.name: Strength check
blocks.instruction: Work to one set of 3 at RPE 8 on the trap-bar or conventional deadlift. Record load and compare with Week 1 training.

blocks.name: MTP check
blocks.instruction: If an approved dynamometer is available, complete the official protocol. Otherwise complete 3 x 3 sec rack pulls at RPE 8 and record setup and load without calling it an official score.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Split squat 2 x 8 each leg; calf raise 2 x 12; tibialis raise 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy bike or walk.

sessions.coach_note: A deadlift number is not a Mid-Thigh Pull score. Keep the records separate.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic recovery
sessions.purpose: Maintain the aerobic base while reducing fatigue before the run test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 25-35 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 3 x 15 sec relaxed accelerations.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 5-8 min calves, hips and ankles.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record general freshness and any recurring pain.

sessions.coach_note: Nothing in this session should compromise Session 4.

sessions.title: Medicine-ball midpoint test
sessions.purpose: Measure throwing progress and keep upper-body strength ticking over.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder mobility and 3-4 progressive practice throws.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Official-style seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 3 scored attempts. Record the longest valid throw.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press or dumbbell bench: 3 x 5 at RPE 6-7; row 3 x 8; pulldown or pull-up 3 x 6-8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 easy sets and shoulder mobility.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Compare best distance with Week 1 and note the technical change that helped most.

sessions.coach_note: Testing ends after three scored attempts. More fatigue will not produce a better valid result.

sessions.title: Midpoint 2 km assessment
sessions.purpose: Measure current running fitness and generate new training paces.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running, drills, strides and an 800 m progressive warm-up.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Run 2 km at best sustainable effort. Record total time and intermediate splits.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: Walk 5 min and jog easily for 8-10 min.

blocks.name: Recalculate
blocks.instruction: Use the new average 400 m or kilometre pace for Weeks 9-11.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Compare pacing, not only finishing time.

sessions.coach_note: A small improvement with better pacing is still meaningful progress.

sessions.title: Easy movement and review
sessions.purpose: Reduce fatigue and convert the midpoint results into a practical final-block plan.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 25-30 min bike, row or brisk walk at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 10 min calves, ankles, hips, thoracic spine and shoulders.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Complete the midpoint worksheet: strength, throw, 2 km, session completion and pain history.

blocks.name: Decision
blocks.instruction: Choose the low or high end of future repetition ranges based on consistency, not ambition.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: Plan the next seven days of sleep, food and rest around the harder final block.

sessions.coach_note: The goal is to leave the midpoint week motivated and recovered, not battered by testing.

sessions.title: Strength specificity + pull force
sessions.purpose: Convert the strength base into higher-force, lower-repetition work.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy machine, mobility and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 4 x 3 at RPE 8.

blocks.name: Pull position
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh rack isometric: 5 x 3 sec at RPE 9, 2-3 min rest.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Front squat or goblet squat 4 x 5 at RPE 8; single-leg Romanian deadlift 3 x 6 each side; calf raise 4 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Farmer carry 4 x 35 m at RPE 8.

sessions.coach_note: Strength improves through intent and repeatability. Do not turn triples into accidental fives.

sessions.title: Long aerobic run
sessions.purpose: Maintain the aerobic foundation while the specific speed work becomes harder.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk into easy running.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 45-50 min at RPE 4-5. Foundation option: 9 min run / 1 min walk.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with 75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk and lower-leg work.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record distance and compare effort with Week 6.

sessions.coach_note: Faster easy running is welcome only when it remains easy.

sessions.title: Upper contrast power
sessions.purpose: Develop high-force pressing and rapid force expression for the medicine-ball throw.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder mobility, light throws and progressive bench sets.

blocks.name: Contrast block
blocks.instruction: 4 rounds: bench press 4 reps at RPE 8, rest 60 sec, then 3 seated medicine-ball throws. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Pull
blocks.instruction: Pull-up or pulldown 4 x 6; chest-supported row 4 x 8.

blocks.name: Overhead
blocks.instruction: Push press 4 x 3 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 controlled sets and Pallof press 3 x 10 each side.

sessions.coach_note: The throw is the priority. If pressing fatigue kills speed, reduce the bench load.

sessions.title: 300 m speed reserve
sessions.purpose: Run slightly faster than current 2 km pace so assessment pace feels more controllable.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 15 min easy running, drills and 4 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 8-10 x 300 m at approximately 1-2 sec per 100 m faster than current 2 km pace. Recover with 90 sec walk/jog.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Calf and hip mobility.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Stop at 8 if pace drops more than 3% or mechanics deteriorate.

sessions.coach_note: Speed reserve is not sprinting. Run fast, relaxed and repeatable.

sessions.title: Loaded walk - sustained posture
sessions.purpose: Build controlled endurance under a moderate load without excessive impact.

blocks.name: Preparation
blocks.instruction: Backpack load: approximately 10% bodyweight, capped at 10 kg. Use comfortable socks and a stable pack.

blocks.name: Main walk
blocks.instruction: 45 min brisk walk at RPE 5 over flat-to-rolling terrain.

blocks.name: After walk
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12 step-ups each leg, 3 x 10 press-ups and 3 x 30 sec front plank.

blocks.name: Foot care
blocks.instruction: Inspect and document hotspots. Treat setup problems before the final loaded session.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Mobility and hydration.

sessions.coach_note: The load stays moderate because the programme is building readiness, not simulating a selection course.

sessions.title: Heavy doubles + lower-body power
sessions.purpose: Increase force while retaining speed and athletic movement.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy machine, mobility and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 2 at RPE 8.5. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Box jump or broad jump: 5 x 3, full reset and safe landing. Use a low box if inexperienced.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Walking lunge 3 x 8 each leg at RPE 8; hamstring curl 3 x 8; calf raise 4 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Heavy suitcase carry 4 x 30 m each side.

sessions.coach_note: Power repetitions end when jump height or landing quality falls.

sessions.title: Continuous threshold
sessions.purpose: Improve the ability to hold a hard but controlled pace without recovery breaks.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12-15 min easy running and strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 20 min continuous at RPE 7-8. Foundation option: 2 x 10 min with 2 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Lower-leg work and mobility.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record average pace and whether effort rose sharply in the final five minutes.

sessions.coach_note: Start controlled. The goal is a strong twenty minutes, not a fast first six.

sessions.title: Explosive upper-body peak
sessions.purpose: Emphasise speed and force without excessive muscle damage.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder mobility, light throws and progressive push press sets.

blocks.name: Power strength
blocks.instruction: Push press: 6 x 2 at RPE 8, full recovery.

blocks.name: Throw
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 6 x 2 at maximum valid intent.

blocks.name: Strength support
blocks.instruction: Dumbbell bench 3 x 6 at RPE 7; pull-up or pulldown 4 x 5-8; row 3 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Face pull 3 x 15 and side plank 2 x 35 sec each side.

sessions.coach_note: This session should feel powerful, not like a bodybuilding burnout.

sessions.title: Specific mixed intervals
sessions.purpose: Hold 2 km pace under controlled accumulated fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 15 min easy run, drills and strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 3 x 800 m at current 2 km pace with 2.5 min recovery, then 4 x 200 m slightly faster with 75 sec recovery.

blocks.name: Foundation option
blocks.instruction: 5 x 3 min at RPE 8 with 2 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record all splits and whether the 200 m reps stayed relaxed.

sessions.coach_note: Specific does not mean maximal. Save the all-out effort for the assessment.

sessions.title: Peak military capacity circuit
sessions.purpose: Bring running, carrying, stepping and bodyweight endurance together.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy cardio and movement rehearsal.

blocks.name: Main circuit
blocks.instruction: 25 min quality AMRAP at RPE 7-8: 400 m run, 12 step-ups each leg, 10-20 press-ups, 8 pull-ups/assisted pull-ups or 12 rows, 50 m farmer carry and 10 burpees.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy walk or bike.

blocks.name: Grip
blocks.instruction: 2 x 45 sec dead hang or heavy hold.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record rounds, movement versions and where pace changed.

sessions.coach_note: The first round should look almost too controlled. The last five minutes are where the work happens.

sessions.title: Final pull rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse high-force pulling while reducing total strength volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy machine and progressive lower-body warm-up.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 2 at RPE 8.

blocks.name: MTP rehearsal
blocks.instruction: If a genuine dynamometer is available, complete two official-style 5 sec attempts with full recovery. Otherwise complete 3 x 3 sec rack isometrics at RPE 9.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Split squat 2 x 6 each leg; calf raise 3 x 10; tibialis raise 2 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Light carry 3 x 25 m and easy mobility.

sessions.coach_note: Do not create a fake official score from a gym setup. Record exactly what was tested.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic + strides
sessions.purpose: Maintain aerobic fitness while allowing fatigue to begin falling.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walking.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 30-35 min at RPE 4.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 15 sec smooth and fast with full easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk and lower-leg mobility.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record general freshness.

sessions.coach_note: The run should finish with spring in the legs.

sessions.title: Final medicine-ball rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse the exact test skill and retain upper-body strength.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder mobility and 3 progressive practice throws.

blocks.name: Rehearsal
blocks.instruction: Three official-style seated 4 kg medicine-ball attempts. Record the best valid distance.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press 3 x 3 at RPE 7; pull-up or pulldown 3 x 5-8; row 2 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 easy sets and mobility.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Write one technical cue to use on final test day.

sessions.coach_note: Once the scored throws are complete, stop testing.

sessions.title: 1 km rehearsal + speed
sessions.purpose: Confirm 2 km rhythm and maintain speed without a full test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 15 min easy running, drills and strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 2 x 1 km at current 2 km pace with 4 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: Speed
blocks.instruction: 4 x 200 m relaxed-fast with 90 sec recovery.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record whether the second kilometre matched the first.

sessions.coach_note: Finish believing you could have completed another hard kilometre.

sessions.title: Final loaded walk
sessions.purpose: Complete the final controlled load exposure before the taper.

blocks.name: Preparation
blocks.instruction: Backpack load: approximately 10% bodyweight, capped at 10 kg. Do not increase it because this is the final session.

blocks.name: Main walk
blocks.instruction: 45-50 min brisk walk at RPE 5 on familiar terrain.

blocks.name: After walk
blocks.instruction: 2 easy rounds: 10 step-ups each leg, 10 press-ups, 10 rows and 30 sec plank.

blocks.name: Foot care
blocks.instruction: Final equipment and footwear check. Resolve hotspots before assessment or training.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Mobility and full recovery meal.

sessions.coach_note: The final loaded walk should build confidence, not produce soreness that lasts into Week 12.

sessions.title: Lower-body primer
sessions.purpose: Keep strength and pulling intent without creating fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy bike or row and mobility.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 3 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Pull primer
blocks.instruction: Mid-thigh rack isometric: 3 x 2 sec at RPE 7, or skip if no safe setup.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Goblet squat 2 x 6; calf raise 2 x 10; tibialis raise 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy movement.

sessions.coach_note: Everything should feel fast and easy. Do not turn the primer into a test.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic primer
sessions.purpose: Maintain rhythm and reduce stress before the final assessment.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 20-25 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 12 sec relaxed-fast with full recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Gentle mobility and hydration.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record freshness, not pace.

sessions.coach_note: You cannot gain fitness this week, but you can hide it under fatigue.

sessions.title: Upper-body power primer
sessions.purpose: Keep the throwing pattern explosive without soreness.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Shoulder mobility and light medicine-ball practice.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 3 x 2 at 85-90% effort.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press or dumbbell bench: 2 x 5 at RPE 6; row 2 x 8; pulldown 2 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: One easy press-up set and mobility.

blocks.name: Cue
blocks.instruction: Write the single cue you will use for the final throw.

sessions.coach_note: Stop while you feel powerful.

sessions.title: 2 km pace primer
sessions.purpose: Touch assessment pace without accumulating fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy running and drills.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 4 x 200 m at current 2 km pace with 2 min full easy recovery.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 2 x 12 sec relaxed-fast.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min very easy running or walking.

blocks.name: Preparation
blocks.instruction: Confirm route, footwear, timing device and assessment plan.

sessions.coach_note: The 200 m reps should feel controlled. This is a reminder, not a workout.

sessions.title: Final fitness assessment
sessions.purpose: Measure the complete 12-week outcome under a consistent, repeatable protocol.

blocks.name: General warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy cardio and dynamic movement.

blocks.name: Medicine-ball test
blocks.instruction: After progressive practice, complete 3 official-style seated 4 kg throws. Record the longest valid result.

blocks.name: Mid-Thigh Pull
blocks.instruction: Use a proper dynamometer where available: 2 x 5 sec attempts with full recovery. If unavailable, record your gym proxy separately.

blocks.name: Run warm-up
blocks.instruction: Complete 10 min easy running, drills, strides and the 800 m progressive warm-up.

blocks.name: 2 km test
blocks.instruction: Run 2 km at best sustainable effort. Record total time and splits.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Compare Week 1, Week 8 and Week 12. Record progress, lessons and the next training objective.

sessions.coach_note: The result matters, but so does the athlete built across the twelve weeks. Finish the test; do not finish your training journey.

training_terms.short: Reps in reserve — how many good reps you could still do.
Mid-Thigh Pull — isometric pull against a fixed bar.
A planned week of reduced volume to absorb training.
Reduced volume before a test to arrive fresh.
Progressive backpack walking at controlled pace.

tests.name: Mid-Thigh Pull
tests.protocol: Pull upward against a fixed bar at mid-thigh for 5 sec. Two attempts, highest score.

tests.name: Seated Medicine-Ball Throw
tests.protocol: Seated against wall, 4 kg ball, three attempts, longest valid throw.

tests.name: 2 km Run
tests.protocol: After 800 m warm-up, continuous 2 km on a flat course.

strength_rpe.use: Comfortably hard; most early strength volume
Hard but controlled; key strength development
Not used for normal training sets
